calls.reason: This is a hedged forecast. Anthropic’s November product updates show continued competition, but the packet supplies no matched customer price increases establishing the predicted pattern.

Cursor cites higher token consumption and announced $900 million in funding. Neither settles the alleged cash crunch, and no independent billing or liquidity records establish the claimed causal chain.
Cursor’s pricing explanation does not disclose AWS spending. The packet has no independent monthly bills confirming either the June increase or spending through September.
The filing reports positive operating cash flow alongside an operating loss and timing effects. It establishes neither lasting sustainability nor whether dramatic price increases are necessary.
Unchanged Sonnet tariffs and reported subscription limits give mixed signals about customer costs. The packet lacks representative bills and inference-only spending to assess Anthropic’s cost burden.
The spending ratio is explicitly conjectural. Anthropic’s Google expansion announcement concerns future capacity and supplies no comparable Google and AWS spending totals through September 2025.
